Name: Pinzon Galaxy Table Lamp, Bronze
Colors: Bronze
Modern design table lamp adds artistic complement as well as utility to any décor Bronze-colored, chrome-plated base with shallow straight drum cotton shade; gold cord Requires 1 bulb up to 100 watts; UL listed; 1-way switch Some easy assembly required on arrival; other colors available Measures 28 inches high by 19 inches wide; weighs approximately 10 pounds
